stocks.name: Apple

stocks.name: Amazon
stocks.summary: Amazon edged up 1.0% on the day, though it’s down 4.1% over the month and up 10.0% YTD, sitting 12.3% under its 52‑week high. The next inflection point will be Amazon’s retail and cloud growth guidance, especially any shifts in consumer spending.

stocks.name: Tesla
stocks.summary: Tesla rose 0.6% today but is down 6.7% week‑to‑date and 19.0% YTD, sitting 27.6% below its 52‑week high. Investors should monitor production updates and margin trends as the stock seeks a bottom near its low‑range support.

stocks.name: Broadcom
stocks.summary: Broadcom slipped 1.1% on the day, down 5.0% month‑to‑date and up only 1.6% YTD, trading 26.8% under its 52‑week high. The next catalyst is the company’s semiconductor demand outlook and any guidance on its 5G portfolio.

stocks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
stocks.summary: AMD jumped 0.7% today, up 30.0% this month and a staggering 173.8% YTD, just 3.0% shy of its 52‑week high after a massive run from its low. Watch for the upcoming earnings beat and GPU/CPU market share gains as the next driver.

stocks.name: Oracle

stocks.name: Coca-Cola
